description: Restyle the Navbar, Hero, About, and Skills (TechStack) sections in src/sections/ with the new dark-first indigo/purple design system established in FEAT-001. All existing JSX logic (scroll spy, animations, i18n, sound toggle, role cycling, email copy, stats grid, skill filters) is preserved — only visual presentation is upgraded. This feat depends on FEAT-001 completing successfully (sections exist in src/sections/, global.css has new variables, tailwindcss plugin wired).
steps: Step 1 — Restyle src/components/Navbar.jsx (keep in components/ since it is imported by pages too): Apply the new glassmorphism navbar: use CSS var --nav-bg with backdrop-filter blur(20px). Add a scroll-progress bar at top using the existing scrollProgress state — style it with accent gradient (background: var(--accent-gradient)). The logo brand text 'Selamsew Alemu' should use gradient-text class. Nav link active state: underline with --accent-primary color and a small glowing dot indicator. The Hire Me button: use gradient background (var(--accent-gradient)). Mobile drawer: animate with slideDown @keyframe. Theme toggle button: rounded-full with glass style. All existing functionality (scrollToSection, sound toggle, i18n, route awareness) must be preserved exactly.

Step 2 — Restyle src/sections/Hero.jsx: Full viewport height (min-h-screen). Background: pure CSS animated gradient blob using a ::before pseudo-element or a dedicated div with radial-gradient animation using gradientShift @keyframe (indigo to purple). Profile card on the right: glassmorphism (backdrop-blur, --bg-glass background, --border-glass border). Profile image: circular with a glowing ring using box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-primary), 0 0 40px rgba(99,102,241,0.4). Animated job title cycling: add a smooth fade transition (opacity + translateY, 300ms) when the activeRoleIndex changes — use a key prop on the span to trigger remount animation. CTA buttons: 'View Projects' uses gradient background, 'Download CV' uses outline style with --accent-primary border. Social icons row: add GitHub, LinkedIn, Telegram icon links from personalInfo below the action buttons with hover scale and color animations. Animated scroll-down chevron indicator at the bottom. Stats grid: each stat card is a glass card with the number in gradient text. Availability pill: pulsing green dot retained. Keep all existing logic (localTime, copyEmail, downloadCV, role cycling). The hero must have id='home' on the section tag.

Step 3 — Restyle src/sections/About.jsx: Two-column layout. Left column: biography text with gradient accent on section titles, objective box with left border in --accent-primary. Right column: quick facts cards with glass styling, icons colored with --accent-cyan and --accent-primary. The 4 core-strengths cards at bottom: glass cards with gradient icon backgrounds. Status banner: emerald glow. Keep all existing i18n keys and scrollToSection calls. Section must have id='about'.

Step 4 — Restyle src/sections/Skills.jsx (was TechStack.jsx): The 4-card bento grid layout is already good — upgrade each card with glassmorphism. Card headers: icon badge uses gradient background. Category filter pills: active state uses gradient background. Language items: progress-style indicator replaced with a colored dot indicating level (Expert = indigo, Advanced = cyan, Proficient = purple). The bento grid: 2x2 on desktop (grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr)), single column on mobile. Each bento card: rounded-3xl, glass background. Skill chips: glass mini-cards with hover: border-indigo-500/30. Keep all existing filter logic, i18n, and section id='skills'. Hidden anchor spans for id='languages', id='frameworks', id='stack' must be retained.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with zero errors
Navbar shows glassmorphism effect with gradient logo text and gradient scroll-progress bar
Hero section fills minimum viewport height, shows animated gradient background blob
Hero profile card has glowing border ring around profile image
Hero CTA 'View Projects' button has gradient background
Hero shows social icon links row below action buttons
About section has two-column layout with glass cards
Skills section bento cards have glassmorphism styling
All existing i18n translations still work (language switcher switches text in all 3 languages)
Scroll-spy active section indicator still highlights the correct nav link
Theme toggle still switches between dark and light modes
